body: 0 INTAKE. Anomaly: Dimensional scores the Thinking function Low (2) and Feeling High (4), yet the facets Analytical Thinking and Logical are High (4); the AuDHD findings say an analytical mask formed through compensation (#15). Expected: a real tension about how he decides (contradicted by the sheet; prediction discarded). Arrived from: the Dimensional x AuDHD comparison, 2026-10-30. 1 LEVEL. Title: 'thinking'. Plot: the Thinking function is a Jungian-type decision preference (impersonal logic vs values as the deciding criterion); Analytical Thinking and Logical describe a reasoning style he reports using. Different referents. Structural check on the app: every cognition pair sums to 6 (Introversion 1 / Extroversion 5, Sensing 1 / Intuition 5, Thinking 2 / Feeling 4, Judging 2 / Perceiving 4), which is consistent with bipolar scoring of each pair (items not seen). Outside literature: the MBTI thinking-feeling scale tracks Big Five Agreeableness rather than reasoning ability (McCrae & Costa 1989; not re-checked this session). Theme: none shared beyond the word. Exclusion test cannot be completed at theme level. STOP: title-level coincidence. 4b (noted, not run as a verdict): his own account (decides by feeling, analyses as a trained skill) has logic-use and values-deciding both high at once, which a bipolar T-F scale cannot record. 6 ROUTING. Verdict: no mapping; tension dissolved at the level check. Admissible as a lexicon note: 'Thinking function' (Dimensional) does not mean analytical ability. What it changes: the T2 tension in the Overlap tab is withdrawn; finding #15 is untouched. Does not license: 'analysis isn't really me'. Trap: reading the Low Thinking score as evidence the analytical mask is fake. Falsifier: if Dimensional's Thinking-function items turn out to ask about reasoning ability rather than deciding criteria, the title-level verdict fails (the items were not seen).
plain: Ran intake on 'Thinking function Low' vs 'Analytical Thinking and Logical High' (and the analytical mask, #15): the match is title-level only; Dimensional's Thinking function is a decision preference, not reasoning ability, so there is no contradiction.

verdict.value: TITLE-LEVEL COINCIDENCE (stopped at level check; no mapping)
